comment: Adherence row 6 (brief ADHERENCE-ROW6-BRIEF.md s3.1-3.2, D-A10..D-A17): the gate rules pre.adherence_gate evaluates on every tool call. A rule applies when every field of `when` holds for the call; it is met when every `needs` entry holds and, if `needs_any` is present, at least one of its entries holds. Every unmet rule is named in one deny (D-A13). needs entries: step:NAME (ledger step done or open), artifact:KIND (a valid TURN.KIND.json), review:sealed (a sealed lane verdict, this or the previous turn, fresh), override:KEY (the key was applied from an override file that predates the session). Path categories are the D38 table as data.

blueprint.hint: {turn_id,session_id,producer:"model",step:"blueprint",unit,doing(10+ chars),steps:[{do(5+ chars),verify:{kind:cmd|manual,cmd(3+ chars when kind=cmd)}}](1+),output(10+ chars),verified_by:{kind,cmd},stops_if(5+ chars),ts}; at depth 3+ every step verify must be kind cmd; a verify the runtime cannot run counts as open, never done

depth.hint: {turn_id,session_id,producer:"model",step:"depth",unit,depth:1..5 (only a raise over the rubric counts),reason(10+ chars),ts}

rules.name: classify
rules.note: runtime fact; bootstrap row when the ledger is missing

rules.name: depth
rules.reason: the rubric's depth is missing from the facts file; depth.json may only raise it

rules.name: placement
rules.reason: a new path needs a placement: the engine found no domain, so write the placement artifact

rules.name: blueprint
rules.reason: the BLUEPRINT is an artifact the runtime validates and whose verify commands it runs at Stop

rules.name: build-layer-l0
rules.note: L0 by rule: plugin and shared runtime paths ship to the fleet

rules.name: build-layer-holding
rules.reason: holding-side implementation must declare L1 (with promotion fields) or L2 (instance-only, with a reason)

rules.name: second-lane
rules.reason: a governance path at depth 3+ needs a sealed second-lane verdict (this or the previous turn) or the audited override key

rules.name: second-lane-unconfigured
rules.reason: no review lane is configured on this box (no DeepSeek key, no codex); the runtime cannot corroborate this edit

rules.name: runtime-owned
rules.reason: the runtime's own switch, override file, key or session stamp (D-A15)

collapsed_steps.comment: Legacy PreToolUse gate registrations whose decision the runtime records to TURN.truthdiff.jsonl and drops when SUTRA_ADHERENCE_GATE_ARMED=1 for the event (brief s3.4, D-A12/D-A17). Unarmed (flag not exactly on, kill-switch, jq or pipeline missing) they decide as before.
